design_summary: One continuous mountain with a horizontal granite-limestone contact at Y=200. No V-shaped ravine. Composite terrane plaque moved to the service tunnel contact crossing at (-40, 200, -360). Service tunnel is now an ASCENDING inclined minecart bore (3.33:1 grade) from Y=0 at SubTropolis to Y=200 at Cheyenne. Return route is funicular + summit road (no skybridge). New 7th centerpiece: Summit Observation Platform at Y=800. Geologically honest: real granite plutons push up through limestone in mountain ranges worldwide.
design_changes_vs_v1_0: V-shaped ravine dropped; one continuous mountain with single dominant granite peak
Composite terrane plaque moved from ravine bottom to service tunnel contact crossing at (-40, 200, -360)
Service tunnel: horizontal-under-ravine -> ASCENDING 3.33:1 grade from Y=0 to Y=200 (climbs through the contact)
Return route: funicular + skybridge + road -> funicular + summit road (NO skybridge)
New 7th centerpiece: Summit Observation Platform at Y=800 (replaces skybridge as return-route payoff)
Surface expression of the contact: 1-2 block color-change ring on the south face for the full 800-block E-W extent

scale.vertical_exception: Granite peak at Y=800 represents a 2:1 vertical compression of the real 2,915 m Pikes Peak

world_footprint.build_y_range: Y = -100 (SubTropolis floor) to Y = 800 (granite peak summit)
